stdout:
usage: model_route.py routes [-h] [--all] [--json] [--health]

Print every global route pool (utility, junior, senior, principal, design,
writing) with each model's weight, effort band, caveats and live availability.
By default available models print in full and the unavailable or cooling ones
collapse to a per-pool count line; `--all` lists every entry.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --all       print every pool entry, including unavailable and cooling models
  --json      print one fabric.routes.v1 JSON document
  --health    also print task-class routes and recent route health (the `route
              health` view)
